name: confluence
title: Confluence
description: Read standards and background pages for specs and policy skills, and publish approved outputs (spec summaries, release notes, lessons) where teams look for them.

vars.name: CONFLUENCE_URL
vars.description: Your Confluence base URL, for example https://your-company.atlassian.net/wiki

vars.name: CONFLUENCE_USERNAME
vars.description: Account email used with the API token

vars.name: CONFLUENCE_API_TOKEN
vars.description: API token with the least privilege needed (read-only first)

access: Start read-only. Publishing to a space needs a named approver; never publish credentials, client names, or personal data.
notes: Uses the same community Atlassian server as Jira, enabled by the CONFLUENCE variables. Verify before rollout, or swap for your organization's approved server via the company template.
